summary: DISTRIBUTION_RECOVERY: PASS - v0.3.4 recovers the public distribution path around the npm/cli #9870 npx regression. The primary documented lifecycle is now a stable package-manager-installed launcher: npm install -g @ran-sh/dsh-crew then dsh-crew install|status|update|uninstall; README.md/README.zh.md no longer present transient npx execution as the supported path and document the compatibility issue concisely. Identity bumped to 0.3.4 across package.json/RUNTIME_VERSION/CHANGELOG with the single bin dsh-crew -> ./bin/dsh-crew.mjs unchanged. dsh-crew update is now a real registry-aware operation: it resolves the newest permitted package via npm pack against the user's configured registry (no policy/config mutation), never downgrades a newer managed payload (proven LIVE against public latest=0.3.3 while 0.3.4 was installed), and accepts explicit safe overrides (--candidate <dir|.tgz> / DSH_CREW_CANDIDATE) with identity verification; staging/validation/commit/activation semantics unchanged - durable Crew-owned release under ~/.config/dsh-crew/app, prior usable release retained until activation succeeds, stale-payload/junction repair with SHA-verified byte-identical config.json/.env sentinels; the global launcher intentionally does not self-replace and both update and status print the exact divergence note plus refresh command. A real Windows disposable-prefix lifecycle (npm install -g --prefix <disposable> from the packed 0.3.4 candidate, then dsh-crew install -> status -> update -> status -> uninstall -> status through the generated dsh-crew.cmd shim) passed end-to-end; the managed payload kept working after deleting the tarball/pack inputs and any npx cache; source-checkout setup.mjs install/status/uninstall passed in a separate disposable home. Focused lifecycle tests grew to 30 cases (candidate dir/tgz/registry resolution incl. failure and identity-mismatch paths, non-downgrade guard, CLI --candidate plumbing); full suite 479/479, client build clean, verify:npm-install and official cohort audit (20 peers/21 manifests/177 checks) pass for candidate=0.3.4, pack audit clean (88 files, zero forbidden), publish dry-run only. Public state untouched: versions [0.3.0-0.3.3] with latest=0.3.3, @ran-sh/dsh-crew@0.3.4 absent, no v0.3.4 tag ref, GitHub Release v0.3.4 HTTP 404. final_machine_state: INSTALLED
